name: Sabine Nagel
bio:
Sabine Nagel is a highly skilled tattoo artist from Dießen, Germany, boasting an impressive portfolio that includes intricate tribal designs, precise fineline work, and stunning black & gray tattoos. With decades of experience, dating back to 1992, Sabine has mastered a diverse range of styles, from vivid color pieces and photorealistic portraits to both Asian-inspired themes and classic Old & New School tattoos. Her dedication to the craft is evident in the detail and precision of her work, making her a sought-after artist for those seeking custom tattoo artistry.
